summary.text: Chris Karr is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 11 who assumed office in January 2025 after serving in the state House from 2017 to 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A financial consultant and accredited valuation analyst, he was elected Senate president pro tempore in January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Chris Karr was born in Tabor, South Dakota, in 1980.

He received a B.S. in business economics from South Dakota State University and an M.B.A. from the University of South Dakota, owned a business, worked as an accredited valuation analyst and financial consultant, and has taught at the University of South Dakota as an adjunct instructor.
Karr represented South Dakota House of Representatives District 11 from 2017 to 2025, chairing the House Appropriations Committee from 2019 to 2022 and serving as majority whip from 2019 to 2020.
He was elected to the Senate in 2024, defeating Democrat Steve Natz, and the Senate elected him president pro tempore on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the Senate Commerce and Energy Committee and the Senate Government Operations and Audit Committee, among others.
